traditional: A soft contact. Action, conflict, and heat supports growth, fortune, and patronage - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Jupiter tempers the malefic Mars.
modern: Energy meets expansion. Strong drive, confidence, and enthusiasm, sometimes to the point of recklessness. The trine makes this a natural strength: High energy directed toward real accomplishment. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Drive and growth flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what drive and growth have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Big drive and ambition; focus is what turns it into results rather than waste.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: A bold move receives the backing required to become more than a lucky break.
readerCopy.body: A bold move receives the backing required to become more than a lucky break. The staff, money, permits, and public support arrive behind an effort that was already prepared to use them. Mars supplies the drive and labor, while Jupiter widens the reach and confidence behind the action. Under the trine, effort and opportunity reinforce each other without turning speed into recklessness. The project grows quickly because the larger audience meets a team capable of carrying the result.
